function loadRegistryRecord(id): Promise<SFRegistryRecord | null>;

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/registry.ts:168

Resolves a registry id to its full record — pure shard arithmetic (shard = rank ÷ 1000, slot = rank mod 1000), one fetch worst case, cache-hit best case. Out-of-range ids resolve null so stale links degrade silently to the overview chart.

Parameters

id

string

Registry id (star-000042).

Returns

Promise<SFRegistryRecord | null>

The record, or null when unknown/unreachable.
